newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-Polish banks see 96 CPI down at 18.58 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Polish banks see 96 CPI down at 18.58 pct.

text.p: Inflation expectations among Polish banks fell in September for the third month in a row, a monthly Reuter poll of the 24 biggest banks showed on Monday.
Banks predicted year-on-year inflation for the end of this year at 18.58 percent on average, against 18.71 last month and the government's inflation target of 17 percent.
The forecast is a mean average of predictions ranging between 17.87 and 19.40 percent.
Banks forecast monthly inflation in September at an average of 1.41 percent, with a range from 0.30 to 2.50 percent.
Banks predicted year-on-year inflation 12 months ahead, in September 1997, at an average of 16.61 percent with a range from 15.0 to 20.00 percent.
